listings.name: Príncipe Real
listings.title: A tall-ceilinged flat with a piano room
listings.blurb: Old parquet, tall windows, and a salon big enough for a piano, a block from the garden square.
listings.description: A second-floor flat in a 1905 building a block from the Príncipe Real garden. Old parquet floors, ceilings over three and a half metres, and a salon big enough for a grand piano, with two iron balconies onto the street. The two bedrooms face a quiet back garden. The building has no lift, and a wide wooden stair climbs from the entrance. The bathroom was renovated with a walk-in shower. A nook off the kitchen holds a desk.
listings.priceSource: INE, Statistics Portugal, 12 months to March 2026
listings.rentSource: INE, Statistics Portugal, median rent of new leases in Santo António parish, 12 months to March 2026

listings.name: Bica
listings.title: A renovated one-bedroom with a green-tiled kitchen
listings.blurb: Oak floors, a green-tiled kitchen, and the river at the bottom of the street.
listings.description: A renovated one-bedroom on the third floor of a 1920 building in Santos, with the river at the bottom of the street. Oak floors run through, and the kitchen is tiled in green. A lift was added in the 2022 renovation, but the entrance is up four steps from the pavement. The shower is walk- in, behind a glass screen. The bedroom is quiet, at the back. The building allows pets.

listings.rentSource: INE, Statistics Portugal, median rent of new leases in Misericórdia parish, 12 months to March 2026

listings.name: Lapa
listings.title: A river-view flat on a quiet slope
listings.blurb: A tall, quiet flat on the Lapa hill, with a balcony and the Tagus in the windows.
listings.description: A tall, quiet flat on the fourth floor of a 1910 building on the Lapa hill, with the Tagus in the windows. Three bedrooms, a long corridor of cupboards, and a living room that opens onto a balcony over the river. An old cage lift serves every floor, from an entrance hall up two marble steps. Both bathrooms have tubs. The third bedroom, by the kitchen, works as a home office.

listings.name: Campo de Ourique
listings.title: Parquet floors and French windows
listings.blurb: Double doors between the rooms and French windows, above the market streets.
listings.description: A 1935 flat on the third floor above the market streets of Campo de Ourique. Parquet floors, double doors between the rooms, and French windows onto a narrow balcony. Of the two bedrooms, the smaller is set up as a study. The building has no lift. The bathroom has a shower tray and was renewed in 2019. The market, the number 28 tram, and two schools are a few minutes' walk away.

listings.name: Alfama
listings.title: A one-bedroom with a terrace over the river
listings.blurb: At the top of an old stair, a terrace looks over the rooftops to the river.
listings.description: A one-bedroom at the top of an 1890 building in Alfama, reached by a narrow stone stair of four flights; there is no lift. The reward is a terrace that looks over the rooftops to the river. The living room has exposed beams and a small kitchen along one wall, and the bedroom is up a short stair under the roof. The shower is walk-in.

listings.title: A sunny two-bedroom on a tram street
listings.blurb: Light all day, the tram at the door, and the Graça viewpoint around the corner.
listings.description: A sunny two-bedroom on the second floor of a 1920 building on a tram street in Graça, with light all day. The living room opens onto a balcony, and the Graça viewpoint is around the corner. There is no lift; the stair is short and well lit. The kitchen keeps its original tiles, and the bathroom was renewed with a bath. The second bedroom is used as a study.

listings.title: A three-bedroom above the riverfront
listings.blurb: A kitchen that opens onto the balcony, high above the river promenade.
listings.description: A three-bedroom on the ninth floor of a 2004 building above the river promenade. The building is step-free from the street, with two lifts and a concierge. The kitchen opens onto a long balcony over the river. The main bedroom has its own bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a second bathroom has a tub. There is underground parking and a storage room. Pets are allowed.

listings.name: Alvalade
listings.title: A 1950s family flat by the park
listings.blurb: Renovated, with built-in shelves, a family room, and schools and the park nearby.
listings.description: A 1950s family flat on the third floor in Alvalade, renovated in 2021. Built-in shelves line the living room, and a family room opens onto the balcony. The building has a lift, and a new ramp at the entrance makes it step-free. The bathroom has a walk-in shower. Schools and the park are a short walk away. The third bedroom is set up as an office.

listings.title: A two-bedroom five minutes from the surf
listings.blurb: The sea from the balcony and the surf a short walk away.
listings.description: A two-bedroom on the fifth floor of a 2016 building, five minutes' walk from the surf at Carcavelos beach. The balcony looks over the sea. The building has a lift and a step-free entrance, and a storage room for boards and bikes. The main bathroom has a walk-in shower. The train to Lisbon is a ten-minute walk.

listings.title: A white townhouse with a walled garden
listings.blurb: Arched rooms, wooden ceilings, and a walled garden above the bay.
listings.description: A white 1928 townhouse above the bay in Cascais, with arched rooms and wooden ceilings. The front door opens straight from the pavement. A walled garden with a lemon tree sits behind the house, a few steps down from the kitchen. The living rooms are on the ground floor, and all three bedrooms and both bathrooms are upstairs, reached by a tiled stair.

listings.title: A beachfront flat facing the Atlantic
listings.blurb: The Atlantic fills the dining-room windows; the beach is across the road.
listings.description: A beachfront flat on the fourth floor of a 2018 building, with the Atlantic filling the dining-room windows and the beach across the road. The building has a lift from a step-free lobby. There are two bedrooms, the main one with its own bathroom and walk-in shower. A nook by the entrance fits a desk. Pets are not allowed in the building.

listings.title: A tiled house in the hills below the palaces
listings.blurb: A fireplace, a white stair, and a big garden in the cool Sintra hills.
listings.description: A tiled house from 1900 in the cool hills below the Sintra palaces, reached by a stone stair from the lane. The ground floor has a fireplace room, the kitchen, and a dining room, and a white stair leads up to the four bedrooms. There is a bathroom on each floor, the lower one with a bath. The big garden is terraced down the hill, with camellias and an old water tank.

listings.title: A new villa with a pool near the beach
listings.blurb: A pool, a lawn, and open living rooms, a short walk from the beach.
listings.description: A new villa from 2021, a short walk from Carcavelos beach. The house is entered without steps from the drive, and its open living rooms give onto a lawn and a pool. A bedroom suite on the ground floor has a walk-in shower, and three more bedrooms are upstairs. There is a garage for two cars.

listings.description: A white 1965 house on the hill above the bay, with the old town down the hill. From the street, steps climb through the garden to the front door. Inside, the living room and kitchen lead to a balcony for breakfast, and a stair goes up to a roof terrace. The three bedrooms share one bathroom with a bath. The garden is planted with olive trees.
